exchangeFormat: TX: RST + TX county (TQP standard abbreviation). Non-TX US: RST + state (DC→MD). Canada: RST + province. DX: RST + primary country prefix. Bands: all except 60/30/17/12m. Phone/CW/Digital (all digital submodes = one mode). TX works everyone; non-TX works TX only.

scoringRules.scoreFormula: Σ QSO pts × Σ mults (counted ONCE for the QSO Party — not per band, not per mode) + bonuses. Pts: Phone 2, CW & Digital 3. TX works everyone; non-TX scores TX contacts only (non-TX↔non-TX no credit). TX entrant mult = TX counties + US states (excl TX) + 13 Canadian provinces + each DXCC country (excl USA/Canada/AK/HI; DC→MD); extra DXCC = points only. Non-TX entrant mult = TX counties (254 max). TX mobile county-change = new QSO + new county; county-line = separate QSO per county. Claimed/running — the TQP committee re-adjudicates. NOT applied (off-log/self/category): +500 per Texas-mobile-worked-in-5-different-counties tier bonus (per-mobile distinct-county tracking — committee computes); TX-mobile +1000 per county with ≥5 QSOs (entrant-self); power/operator categories.
